مَسْلَمَةٌ : see what next precedes.
المُسَلَّم is said to be used in the sense of ↓ المُسْتَلَم in the saying of El-'Ajjáj, “بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالكَعْبَةِ المُسَلَّممِ
” [Between Es-Safà and the Kaabeh of which the Black Stone is touched with the hand, or kissed: see 8]. (M.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
